subject: project:gdl
value:
AN IMAGE-WIDE, ALIGNMENT-FREE CENSUS OF WRONG-DATUM DEFECTS: 71 functions, taken 2026-09-03 at 88fd36cfa with `python tools/gdl/composed_census/cr_datum_screen.py --image --out build/GUNE5D/cr_image_datum.txt` (1702 function pairs screened, 1631 VALUE-EQUAL) and classed with cr_class_image.py. Unlike both run-41 censuses this one needs no instruction-stream alignment and no count symmetry, so it reaches functions at any real -- which matters, because the ES 30-row census's LOWEST real is 24 and its highest is 3982: not one of its rows sits in a near-matched function, and every row there is entangled with a structural residual.

CLASSES, with the count of functions and TUs:
  pi-literal-precision, 1 fn / 1 TU: retail spells the circle constants as the 10-significant-digit decimals -- lbl_80345F58 = 0x400921FB54524550 = 3.141592654, and 1.570796327 / 6.283185308 / -3.141592654 beside it -- where our sources write full-precision pi, 0x400921FB54442D18. Fixed this run in camera.c (16 relocations across camera_mode_dest); game/game/player::damage_player still carries five of them and is inside another lane's TU.
  string, 18 fns / 8 TUs: a debug or format string that is not retail's. Fixed this run: game/ui/btext::DrawStringText (93/93 at REAL 0 -- 'DrawStringText: Msg %d idx %d > msg count\n' against retail's lbl_801119A0 'DrawStringText: Msg=%d idx=%d > max'). Still open and NOT in this lane's TUs: atree::AtreeNodeInit, audio::AudioStreamPlay ('Audio Stream bad file: %s' against sAudioTimeoutMsg 'Audio Play Timeout'), critter::CritterNewInst (a trailing newline), adstream::adsMoveCookedToSpu, action::DoPlayerAction, combat::screen_limitation ('CAM: %.2f %.2f %.2f' against 'CONTAINER'), and eight player.c functions sharing lbl_80113AE0 'trbo_full_new' against our '16_%sCOIN'.
  small-constant, 46 fns / 21 TUs: one or two literals of the wrong value or the wrong WIDTH.
  broad, 6 fns / 3 TUs: many rows, structural divergence likely; not separable defects.

WHAT THIS LANE FIXED, all six gated on 'ninja build/GUNE5D/main.dol: OK' with matched and the STRICT/EQUIVALENT split (56.63 + 10.09) unchanged: camera_mode_dest's 16 pi relocations; camera_mode_target's 2.0-against-1.0 approach threshold and 0.0174532925-against-0.05 pitch rate (a WEBFRANK-PINNED function reading REAL 0); DoShake's 0.66313 against 0.6632251158444444 (real 0, three references); DrawStringText's error string (real 0); boss.c's `extern f64 Random(f64)` against ml_fmath.c's `f32 Random(f32)`, which widened nine `Random(0.1f)` arguments to the f64 0x3FB99999A0000000 where retail loads the f32 0x3DCCCCCD -- correcting the prototype also took BossSpewCoins real 137 -> 121 and fresh fuzzy 90.2329 -> 93.1190; and update_player_milestone's wrong global (below).

HANDOFF TO THE POOL-VALUE LANE (work_claim.pool-defect-fixes.20260903.v1 owns game/game/player, game/enemy/enemy and game/anim/atree, so this lane did not touch them). Twenty-two player.c functions carry a value delta and these were read from the retail image, not inferred: do_exit 0.1f (lbl_803477DC) against our 1.5f; do_weakening 25.0f and 200.0f (lbl_80347914 / lbl_80347910) against our 50.0f and 150.0f; clear_player 500.0f (lbl_80347984) against our 100.0f; AppendItemToLevel 2.0f (lbl_803478DC) against our 0.6f; check_player_atts 999.0f (lbl_80347994) against our 0.9f; PlayerProcessScale 0.05 and 255.0 (lbl_803478F0 / lbl_803478F8) against our 0.01 and 100.0; set_hidden_player -1.0f (lbl_80347920) against our 1.0f -- a SIGN, and the four-way lbl_803479C8..E0 rotation T11 listed for that function is order-only, this is the real row; damage_player carrying five truncated-pi constants beside 2.0f/0.5; and inactivate_player + PlayersRestoreHealth + PlayerRestoreState all repeating the same 100.0/500.0-against-0.5/30.0 pair the pool-value lane already owns. sfx::UpdateFXStreak is a ONE-ULP literal (0x3FDFFFFFFF768FA0 against our ...FA1).

A GAMEPLAY DEFECT THE RELOCATION CHANNEL FOUND AND FIXED, game/world/items::update_player_milestone at +0x194: retail reads lbl_80344800, the free-running frame counter gamemain.c and sysservice.c increment, and we read sShownMilestones (0x803448F4). Same instruction WORD, so real / --clean / --ops / reloc_set_delta / objdiff fuzzy all called the function unchanged; the milestone icons are meant to blink on frame-counter bit i and instead latched on a persistent bitmask.
